label: Voronoi Cells
blurb: The frame is broken into irregular many sided cells, the shape a crystal or a dried riverbed takes, and the incoming shot claims them one at a time. The cells can turn over in order from a point outward, at random, or in a sweep across the frame, and each one gives a small pop as it lands. A thin line of light runs along every seam so the pattern reads as leaded glass rather than a blur. Nothing falls and nothing breaks: the panes simply change hands.
